title: VF-MT308-FleetManualAndCloseout
clause: UserManual entries for the fleet surface (desired-state model, quarantine recovery, operator override paths), manual self-consistency test, three-tier diagnostics posture recording, cluster-level negative-guard sweep

scope.summary:
GOAL: Close out the VF fleet-reconciler family: write the built-in UserManual entries that let a no-context model (or the operator) understand and operate the fleet surface end to end, prove those entries stay consistent with the code via the manual self-consistency test surface, record the three-tier diagnostics posture for the whole family, and run a cluster-level negative-guard sweep that re-proves the family's hard prohibitions in one place.

WHY A DEDICATED CLOSEOUT MT: MT-301..307 each update their own manual entries incrementally (their user_manual_obligation blocks), but the FAMILY-level narrative - how desired state, the reconciler, lifecycle, failure policy, teardown, and the panel compose into one operating model - has no single owner without this MT, and cross-MT drift (an entry written in MT-301 contradicted by an MT-305 behavior) would otherwise ship silently. The manual is a product surface (GLOBAL-BUILD-002..012: purpose, core workflows, expected inputs/outputs, navigation, safety constraints, common failure modes, recovery steps, operable by a model with no conversation history).

USERMANUAL ENTRIES (authored/reconciled in the existing user_manual system - the seed + behavior-coverage machinery lives at src/backend/handshake_core/src/user_manual/seed.rs and user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs on the WP-1 branch; anchor exact entry-registration and versioning APIs there before writing):
   1. 'Workspace fleet > Operating model': the desired-state contract (Running / Snapshotted-means-parked / Absent), who writes desired state (operator via panel, agents via typed API), who converges it (the crowned reconciler), and why observed state can lag (level-triggered passes, backoff windows). Includes the Pending-until-first-heartbeat rule and what a divergence row in the panel means.
   2. 'Workspace fleet > Quarantine recovery': what quarantine means (N consecutive failures), what keeps happening (slow retry ~15min), how to read last_failure_reason and the FLEET_WORKSPACE_QUARANTINED alert, the two exits (full slow-retry success self-heals; operator clear_quarantine via panel button or typed API), and the guarantee that quarantine never deletes anything.
   3. 'Workspace fleet > Operator override paths': every manual intervention in one place - set desired state, request teardown, clear quarantine, reading stuck-tombstone alerts and unblocking each finalizer step (T1 kill / T2 lease / T3 manifest), plus the recovery answer for 'the reconciler daemon itself is down' (crown released on session death; restart re-crowns; boot pass re-enqueues everything; nothing is lost because state is level-triggered from SurrealDB).
   4. 'Workspace fleet > Safety constraints': never-auto-delete guarantees (failure paths, quarantine, GC posture on snapshot artifacts), resource budgets (MiB/vcpus) and what happens at budget pressure (nothing destructive - budgets gate spawning, never trigger deletion), and the account/Principal scoping of every fleet row and panel view.
   5. 'Workspace fleet > Common failure modes': spawn-succeeds-then-dies (auto-remediated, what the FR trail looks like), stuck tombstone (alert + which step + operator options), listener gap (self-healing via tick, TICK-labeled drift events), crown contention (second instance waits - expected, not an error).
   Entries must state startup/run expectations (daemon starts with the app; no separate service to launch - no new external daemons) and cite the panel author_ids for each referenced control so a model can navigate without screenshots.

MANUAL SELF-CONSISTENCY TEST: extend the existing manual verification surface (user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs pattern - it already binds manual claims to behavior ids on the WP-1 branch) so that: every VF manual entry references only (a) FR event kinds that exist (MT-306's four kinds), (b) panel author_ids that exist (MT-306's registry), (c) typed API names that exist (compile-checked references or a registry lookup), and (d) state names that exist (VmLifecycle variants, health_states, desired states). The test fails when a manual entry names a nonexistent surface or when a VF behavior id has no manual coverage - both directions (manual->code and code->manual).

THREE-TIER DIAGNOSTICS POSTURE RECORDING: produce the family-level record of each MT's hbr_int_009_tier_obligations dispositions as actually landed (FLIGHT_RECORDER: wired in MT-306, deferred notes resolved; INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTICS: contradiction events MT-303, quarantine alerts MT-304, stuck-tombstone + step-failure events MT-305; PALMISTRY: daemon posture from MT-302, N/A elsewhere) in the machine-readable posture format the diagnostics system uses (anchor: the ModelLaneDiagnosticTierStatus/Posture types, model_lane.rs lines 8168-8209, and the diagnostics tier surfaces in the atelier test tree). Every DEFERRED-with-reason left by MT-301..307 must be either resolved or re-recorded with a current reason - no silent expiry.

CLUSTER-LEVEL NEGATIVE-GUARD SWEEP: one test module that re-proves the family's prohibitions across the ENTIRE vm_fleet surface in a single place (so a future MT cannot re-introduce a violation in a corner the original MT's grep missed):
   NG-1 no SurrealQL DELETE against worktree_fleet_desired_state or worktree_vm_bindings anywhere in vm_fleet/ (MT-301/304/305 rule).
   NG-2 no direct CloudHypervisorAdapter reference in vm_fleet/ (MT-303 rule: registry seams only).
   NG-3 no tokio::time::sleep in reconcile/executor/error-policy paths (MT-304 central-policy rule).
   NG-4 no task::abort on reconcile tasks; select! arms pure-wait only (MT-302 rule; enforced by grep + targeted review checklist emitted as test output).
   NG-5 no SQLite, kube, k8s_openapi, bollard, containerd, nomad, madsim identifiers in vm_fleet/, app fleet-panel module, or Cargo.toml (whole-family house rule).
   NG-6 no absolute paths / drive letters / user-profile paths in vm_fleet/ source or SQL (disk-agnostic rule; regex sweep for e.g. '[A-Za-z]:\\' and '/home/' and '/Users/').
   NG-7 no file or folder created by the family carries a space in its name (sweep the diff file list).
   NG-8 fleet queries exclude archived rows by default (assert every list/claim SQL string contains the archived filter - MT-305 rule).
   The sweep runs as cargo tests (grep/regex assertions over the source tree are acceptable test bodies for NG guards) plus a recorded manual review checklist for the two guards greps cannot fully prove (NG-4 select! purity, NG-8 query completeness), with reviewer findings written into the test output.

RESOURCE PRIVACY: manual entries and the posture record explicitly document the account/Principal scoping model (fleet rows and panel views are scoped per the WP-1 resource_scope patterns - resource_scope.rs module rationale lines 1-42, ResourceScope 147-153) so future operators/models treat scoping as a documented contract, not an implementation accident.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: user_manual entry additions + version bump; behavior-coverage bindings for VF entries; the negative-guard test module under tests/; the diagnostics posture record through the existing typed surfaces; NO new product runtime behavior (this MT adds documentation, verification, and recording only - any product-code change discovered necessary is a defect to route back to the owning MT, not to fix here).

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read the landed MT-301..307 modules, their manual entries, user_manual/seed.rs + behavior_coverage.rs registration APIs, and the diagnostics posture types (model_lane.rs 8168-8209).
2. Author the five family-level manual entries with author_id citations; bump the manual version.
3. Extend the self-consistency surface with the four reference classes and both coverage directions; fix any drift found by routing content fixes into the entries (code fixes route back to owning MTs as defects).
4. Record the family diagnostics posture; resolve or re-record every outstanding DEFERRED.
5. Implement NG-1..NG-8 as the sweep module with the recorded review checklist.
6. Run the full family test set (MT-301..307 proof targets) once end-to-end as the closeout regression, plus this MT's targets; record measured output.
7. Implementer never marks COMPLETED - this MT's verdict is the family gate and belongs to the WP validator.

src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/vm_fleet/** (no product-behavior changes in closeout; defects route back to owning MTs)
acceptance_criteria: AC-308-1: Five family-level manual entries exist (operating model, quarantine recovery, operator override paths, safety constraints, common failure modes) with a manual version bump, each operable by a no-context model: purpose, workflows, inputs/outputs, navigation via panel author_ids, safety constraints, failure modes, recovery steps.

AC-308-2: The manual self-consistency test validates all four reference classes (FR kinds, author_ids, typed API names, state names) in both directions (manual->code, code->manual) and passes; a deliberate broken-reference fixture proves the test actually fails on drift.
AC-308-3: The three-tier diagnostics posture for the whole VF family is recorded through the existing typed posture surfaces; zero unresolved DEFERRED-with-reason entries remain unrecorded.
AC-308-4: Negative guards NG-1..NG-8 all pass across the entire vm_fleet surface, fleet panel module, and Cargo.toml; the two review-checklist guards carry recorded reviewer findings in test output.
AC-308-5: The full MT-301..307 proof-target set passes once end-to-end as the closeout regression, recorded with per-owner CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/.
AC-308-6: This MT changes no product runtime behavior: the diff touches only user_manual, tests, and posture recording (diff-scope proof target).
AC-308-7: Manual entries document the never-auto-delete guarantees and the account/Principal scoping contract explicitly.
AC-308-8: Any drift or defect found during closeout is recorded (test output + completion report) with its owning MT named - never silently fixed out of scope.

code_surfaces: src/backend/handshake_core/src/user_manual/seed.rs and user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs (entry registration + manual-claims-to-behavior binding machinery - anchor exact APIs in implementing worktree)
expected_tests: manual self-consistency: four reference classes, both directions, plus a failing-fixture proof
negative-guard sweep NG-1..NG-8 with recorded review checklist output
diagnostics posture recording round-trip through the typed surfaces
full-family closeout regression run of MT-301..307 targets
diff-scope guard proving closeout touched only manual/tests/Cargo.toml
implementation_notes: IMPLEMENTATION GATE: gated on WP-1 IV verdicts + merge to main (expansion_provenance.implementation_gate) and on MT-301..307 all reaching validator-accepted state - closeout of an unfinished family is meaningless.
Defects found here route BACK to the owning MT (reopen/patch under that MT's contract); fixing product code inside the closeout MT would blind the family's per-MT proof story.
The manual is a first-class product surface for no-context models (GLOBAL-BUILD-002..012); write entries so a model that has never seen this WP can operate the fleet from the manual alone.

Grep-based negative guards are deliberately duplicated from per-MT proofs: the cluster sweep exists to catch violations introduced AFTER the original MT landed, in corners the original grep did not cover.

The user_manual seed machinery on the WP-1 branch already contains lease/heartbeat-related manual content (user_manual/seed.rs matched the lease/heartbeat identifier sweep) - reconcile wording with existing entries rather than duplicating them.
All Rust; SurrealDB/EventLedger authority; no SQLite; no K8s/Docker/containerd/Nomad; disk-agnostic paths; no names with spaces.
Implementer never marks COMPLETED; the WP validator's verdict on this MT is the family completion gate.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Closeout MT: manual, verification, and posture recording only. The fleet GUI landed in MT-306; this MT documents and cross-checks it without editing it.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.note: Family posture recording: confirm MT-306's FR wiring landed and resolve every FR DEFERRED note left by MT-301..305; no new FR kinds here.

The posture record itself is the diagnostics deliverable: every family diagnostic surface (contradictions, quarantine alerts, stuck tombstones, step failures) is enumerated with its landed disposition.
No process changes; MT-302's daemon posture is confirmed, not modified.

risk_if_missed: The fleet family ships as seven islands: no single operating narrative for operators or no-context models, manual entries drift from code with no test catching it, DEFERRED diagnostics notes expire silently, and prohibition regressions (a future DELETE, a direct adapter call, a madsim dependency) land in corners no per-MT grep still watches.

risks: RISK-1: Manual entries describe intended rather than landed behavior, and the self-consistency test checks only that names exist, not that described workflows match reality.
RISK-2: Closeout quietly patches product code to make guards pass, hollowing out the per-MT proof story.
RISK-3: The negative-guard sweep is grep-only theater: guards that need semantic review (select! purity, query completeness) get rubber-stamped.
RISK-4: DEFERRED diagnostics notes are marked resolved without the underlying wiring existing.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): Both-direction coverage binding through behavior ids (code->manual direction forces entries for real behaviors) plus the failing-fixture proof (AC-308-2); validator spot-checks one workflow per entry against the live app.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): Diff-scope proof target restricts the closeout diff to manual/tests/Cargo.toml (AC-308-6); defects route back by contract (AC-308-8).
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): NG-4/NG-8 require recorded reviewer findings in test output, named as manual review, never presented as automated proof (AC-308-4).
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): Posture recording goes through the typed diagnostics surfaces with evidence refs, and the validator cross-checks each resolved DEFERRED against the landing MT's diff (AC-308-3).

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
